# Patched third-party crates

Third-party crates with Spark Commander's changes.

## gpui-component 0.7.3 (GPUI Kit)

`gpui-component/` is the published crate from crates.io with Spark Commander's changes,
wired in through `[patch.crates-io]` in the workspace `Cargo.toml`. License:
Apache-2.0 (`gpui-component/LICENSE-APACHE`). Each modified file starts with
a notice, and every change is marked `SparkCommander patch`.

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/dialog/dialog.rs`, `src/dialog/alert_dialog.rs` | a dialog moves by dragging its title; `Dialog::center_over` opens it centred over part of the window (the work area a message is about); dialogs fade in where they open instead of sliding down; SparkCommander patch: the title is small text (`text_sm`, upstream `text_base`) and a long one ends in "…" instead of running under the close button; the default Cancel button takes its label from a `CancelLabel` global, which the app sets to its own translation (GPUI Kit's is in English, Chinese and Italian only); the default alert's OK comes before Cancel where a `MainButtonFirst` global is set (the app sets it on Windows and KDE), after it elsewhere, as macOS and GTK order them; SparkCommander patch: a dialog given no place of its own opens in the middle of the window (upstream: a tenth down) |
| `src/native.rs`, `src/dialog/dialog.rs`, `src/dialog/alert_dialog.rs`, `src/lib.rs` | SparkCommander patch: with `NativeControls::dialog_frame` (`DialogFrame`, `WindowClose`), a dialog's title bar is the desktop's window title bar: its height, its fill and text with the window focused and not; KWin's decoration with the app's icon at the left (`AlertIcon`) and the decoration's outline when focused: Breeze (the title centred, a cross on a red circle under the pointer), Klassy (a cross, white on a red rounded cell of the bar's height under the pointer), another (a cross on a faint cell); GNOME's header bar (the title bold and centred, a cross on a faint circle), Windows 11's caption (the title small at the left, a 46 px close cell red under the pointer). On KDE and Windows an alert's title goes into it, as their message boxes are windows |
| `src/highlighter/mod.rs`, `src/highlighter/input_adapter.rs` | `input_highlighter_factory` is public, so the app can wrap the editor's tree-sitter highlighter; a background parse asked for no folds leaves the fold candidates alone instead of clearing them, so the app can give its own |
| `src/input/popovers/completion_menu.rs` | the completion menu is as wide as `CompletionMenuOptions::max_width`; sized to its first measured item, it stayed too narrow for later items |
| `src/kbd.rs` | a key binding of several keystrokes (a chord, Ctrl+K Ctrl+0) shows them all, not only the first; SparkCommander patch: the numpad's `add`, `subtract`, `multiply`, `divide` show as Num +, Num -, Num *, Num / |
| `src/list/list.rs` | `ListState::confirm_on_double_click`: a click only selects, a double click or Enter confirms |
| `src/menu/app_menu_bar.rs`, `src/menu/mod.rs` | menu-bar menus may be as tall as the window minus 48 px (upstream: half the window, at most 450 px, then scrolling); SparkCommander patch: `AppMenuBar::built` makes a bar of a window's own menus (the viewer's), each built by a `MenuBuilder` as it opens, so it shows the window's state then; SparkCommander patch: an open menu's name is drawn in the theme's `primary` colour with `primary_foreground` text, as KDE's menu bar does; on Windows 11 (`NativeControls` with a card) in the faint fill of a hovered menu item (`accent`), its text unchanged, as WinUI's menu bar; SparkCommander patch: with a `MenuMnemonics` global, the menus' names have their letter underlined, and `AppMenuBar::open_by_key` opens the menu whose letter is pressed with Alt (the app calls it from its window's key handler) |
| `src/button/dropdown_button.rs` | SparkCommander patch: a ghost `DropdownButton`'s caret half is 18 px wide (upstream as wide as tall), as a toolbar's Back and Forward |
| `src/menu/menu_item.rs`, `src/menu/popup_menu.rs` | SparkCommander patch: menu items are rounded, and the highlighted one is framed in the theme's `ring` colour, as KDE's Breeze menus; unframed on Windows 11; on macOS (`MacControls`) filled with the accent, its text and key white, as AppKit's |
| `src/command/command.rs`, `src/command/item.rs`, `src/command/state.rs` | SparkCommander patch: `CommandItem::keys_of(action)` shows that action's key on the row without dispatching it (Quick Open runs its picks itself); `Command::action_context(handle)` looks the rows' keys up as if that handle had the focus, as `PopupMenu::action_context` |
| `src/menu/popup_menu.rs` | SparkCommander patch: every menu and submenu may be as tall as the window minus 16 px (upstream: menus of over 20 items scroll within half the window, at most 450 px); only a menu taller than that scrolls, by wheel and keys, and no menu shows a scrollbar; `scrollable()` has no effect; `with_menu_items` is public, for a ☰ button's menu of the app's menus; SparkCommander patch: a submenu may run an action of its own when clicked, its key shown before the arrow (Konsole's New Tab): a menu-bar submenu whose first item has its name runs that item, and lists the items after it and a separator; `highlighted()`, `highlight(ix)` and `pick(ix)` are public: a list over a panel highlights or picks by a typed letter (Total Commander's drive list); SparkCommander patch: with a `MenuIcons` global, an app menu's unchecked items show the icon it gives for their action; items' icons and checks are 16 px, 8 px from the label (upstream 12 and 4); SparkCommander patch: with a `MenuMnemonics` global, a menu made with `mnemonics(true)` (the menu bar's, the ☰ button's) and its submenus show each item's letter underlined, as the global gives them, and the letter pressed picks that item, as a click, or opens its submenu |
| `src/tree.rs` | `Tree::context_menu` builders get the menu's `Context<PopupMenu>` instead of `Context<TreeState>`, so tree menus can have submenus; the row renderer's `selected` is not overridden, so the app can show several selected rows |
| `src/root.rs`, `src/window_ext.rs` | notifications paint above dialogs (deferred, priority 90); SparkCommander patch: `WindowExt::set_see_through` stops the root painting the window's background, for a window the system's blur or Mica shows through; SparkCommander patch: the root surface's top corners round as the window's (`top_corners`) |
| `src/native.rs` (new), `src/checkbox.rs`, `src/radio.rs`, `src/slider.rs`, `src/progress/progress.rs`, `src/button/button.rs`, `src/select.rs`, `src/tab/tab.rs`, `src/input/input.rs`, `src/lib.rs` | SparkCommander patch: with a `NativeControls` global (the app sets it on KDE, Windows and GNOME), check boxes, radio buttons, sliders, progress bars, push buttons, combo boxes and text fields take the desktop style's colours and the sizes that differ between styles: the box, its corners and frame, the radio dot (Breeze 16, 4, 1 and 6 px; Windows 11 20, 4, 1 and 12 px; GNOME 20, 6, 2 and 8 px), the mark centred in the box (GNOME's bold, as AppKit's), the groove (6, 4, 6 px), a progress bar's groove and fill (6 and 6; 1 under 3; 8 and 8 px), the slider handle's middle, rim and frame; buttons' fill and frame normal, hovered and pressed, the default one's (a dialog's OK) apart, GNOME's labels bold; combo boxes as push buttons on Windows and GNOME; text fields in the style's fill. Breeze's `Tab` tabs are 34 px, the selected one tinted under a 3 px line. Windows': the darker bottom edge of a button's frame, a text field's bottom line in place of its bottom border, 2 px of the accent when focused, the page's fill then, its frame the faint stroke of a button's, no focus ring |
| `src/toolkit.rs` (new), `src/checkbox.rs`, `src/button/button.rs`, `src/lib.rs` | SparkCommander patch: with a `ToolkitControls` global (the app sets it on KDE from `sc-qtstyle`, on Xfce, MATE and Cinnamon from `sc-gtkstyle`), check boxes and push buttons (default, primary, secondary, outlined too) are images the desktop's toolkit drew, its Qt style or GTK 3 theme, one per state: normal, hovered and pressed layered in the control's group, shown as the pointer is over it or presses it; disabled alone. A button's ends are painted as drawn and the middle half of the strip of its middle stretched between (its edges would blend in the next image of GPUI's atlas); its label in the theme's text colour. A box far taller than the label's line (Materia's) is centred on it; a tab's close button where the style draws one (`tab_close`), its states layered by `state_layers` for the app's own controls |
| `src/mac.rs` (new), `src/checkbox.rs`, `src/radio.rs`, `src/slider.rs`, `src/progress/progress.rs`, `src/button/button.rs`, `src/select.rs`, `src/input/input.rs`, `src/group_box.rs`, `src/tab/tab.rs`, `src/tab/tab_bar.rs`, `src/dialog/dialog.rs`, `src/dialog/alert_dialog.rs`, `src/lib.rs` | SparkCommander patch: with a `MacControls` global (the app sets it on macOS), the controls are drawn as AppKit draws them on macOS 26, in the system's colours: 16 px check boxes (5 px corners) and radio buttons filled with the accent and a white mark or 5 px dot when checked, faintly filled when not; sliders' 6 px groove filled with the accent and a 20 × 16 px pill knob; progress bars 8 px; push and pop-up buttons 24 px, filled, unframed, 6 px corners, the default one in the accent, the pop-up's chevrons up and down; text fields 24 px with a faint frame; group boxes faintly filled with 12 px corners, their title small above; `Tab` tabs as window tabs, pills of equal width in a rounded track, a long label cut short with an ellipsis (as with `max_width`) down to 80 px tabs (`MAC_TAB_MIN`, Finder's), past which the bar scrolls; dialogs framed as a window, 16 px corners, a 32 px title bar of their own colour and the red close button on the left; alert dialogs as AppKit's alert, 260 px wide with 24 px corners in its own fill: the app's icon at 64 px (an `AlertIcon` global, which the app sets), the title in bold over the text, both 13 px, on the left; the buttons 28 px capsules sharing the width, or one above the other, OK on top, where a label does not fit half of it; a `Danger` OK button red on a red tint, as a destructive one; `Underline` tabs as a tab view's segmented control, the selected segment in the accent; tooltips in AppKit's small grey box with 11 px text; a `Select` opens AppKit's own pop-up menu (`native_menu::pop_up_list`), the chosen item over the button; context menus and drop-down menus show as AppKit's own (`PopupMenu::show_native`, `native_menu::pop_up_entries`): separators, labels as section headers, check marks, icons, submenus and single-keystroke shortcuts as key equivalents; the item picked runs as a click on it would; a menu with an item that draws itself stays drawn |
| `src/radio.rs` | SparkCommander patch: a radio button's label takes the room beside the circle, so a long label (a translation) wraps inside the row instead of running past it |
| `src/theme/mod.rs`, `src/root.rs` | SparkCommander patch: `Theme::font_fallbacks`, the families tried in order for characters the fonts lack, given to every window by `Root` (the app sets fontconfig's choice per script on Linux: without it GPUI may take a font with Hangul's letters but not its syllables, and Korean shows as loose letters); `Theme::scrollbar_size`, a scrollbar's width and its thumb's width and inset in every state, given to GPUI Base (the app reads AppKit's on macOS) |
| `src/window_border.rs`, `src/lib.rs` | SparkCommander patch: the frame of a window drawing its own rounds its top corners by the `WindowCornerRadius` global (the desktop theme's), square on a side tiled or maximized; `top_corners` gives that radius to what paints into the corners (the root surface, a title bar) |
| `src/styled.rs` | SparkCommander patch: a popup's hairline ring is the theme's `border` colour (upstream: the foreground at 10%), as KDE frames menus |
| `src/tab/tab_bar.rs` | the segmented tab bar's indicator uses the theme's `tab_active` colour instead of the background, so the app can tint the active tab |
| `src/tab/tab.rs` | SparkCommander patch: the selected tab of the `Tab` variant has a 2 px line of the theme's `primary` colour on top, as KDE's Breeze tabs |
| `src/title_bar.rs` | SparkCommander patch: on Linux the title bar shows only the window buttons the desktop's button layout names (GNOME's default: close alone), not every one the compositor supports; with a `WindowButtonPictures` global the buttons are those SVG files (the icon theme's, as GTK draws them) in round 24 px buttons shaded under the pointer |
| `src/table/data_table.rs` | `DataTable::column_lines` draws lines between columns; shift and an arrow extends a range of cells; no focus ring, the selected cell shows where the keys go |
| `src/table/delegate.rs` | `TableDelegate::cell_context_menu`: a right-clicked cell's menu knows its column (by default its row's menu); `TableDelegate::cell_background`: a cell's own background, as a changed value's, filling the cell under the selection's |
| `src/table/state.rs` | a column sorts ascending first, then descending, then as it was (upstream: descending first); clearing the selection drops the right-clicked cell's outline, which otherwise stayed after an action of its menu; in cell selection, the row header shows row numbers, and the selected cell's row number and column header are highlighted; the selected cell gets a background instead of an overlay, which hid the text under an opaque `table_active`; a range of cells is selected by dragging or a shift click (`selected_range`, `set_selected_range`), and right-clicking outside it selects that cell; a right-clicked cell gets its row's context menu, whose actions go to the table; column lines; a cell takes the delegate's `cell_background`; the horizontal scrollbar starts after the row numbers, as its range is measured by its own width (upstream it took the row numbers' width too and stopped that much short of the last column) |

## gpui-base

`gpui-base/` is GPUI Kit's base crate, patched the same way.

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/input/base/state.rs` | moving and deleting by words stops at a `.` between names, as code has them; `set_folded`, `is_folded` and `unfold_all`, so the app folds lines from the keyboard |
| `src/input/base/element.rs` | a multi-line input's placeholder wraps at the input's width instead of running past it |

## gpui-pre-linux 0.3.9 (GPUI's Linux platform)

`gpui-pre-linux/` is GPUI's Linux backend from crates.io, SparkCommander's
own patch, wired in the same way. License: Apache-2.0
(`gpui-pre-linux/LICENSE-APACHE`). `gpui-pre-linux.patch` holds the full
diff against upstream; every change is marked `SparkCommander patch`.

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/linux/clipboard_files.rs` (new), `src/linux.rs` | files on the clipboard as file managers put them: `text/uri-list` with GNOME's `x-special/gnome-copied-files` and KDE's `application/x-kde-cutselection`; an item's `ExternalPaths` entry is the files, its string entry's metadata `cut` marks a cut |
| `src/linux/wayland/client.rs`, `src/linux/wayland/clipboard.rs` | an item with files offers those types too and sends each as asked; another program's URI list reads as files, cut or copied, before its text |
| `src/linux/x11/client.rs`, `src/linux/x11/clipboard.rs` | the same on X11: the types are stored beside the text, and a URI list is read before the text |
| `src/linux/wayland/client.rs`, `src/linux/wayland/window.rs` | a blurred window background also through `ext-background-effect-v1` (blurring the window inside its shadow, given again on every resize), where KDE's own blur protocol is not offered (KWin 6.8, GNOME 51 and other compositors) |
| `src/linux/wayland/client.rs`, `src/linux/wayland/window.rs` | a window's icon (`WindowOptions::icon`) also on Wayland, through `xdg-toplevel-icon-v1` (KWin), as X11's `_NET_WM_ICON`: a build that is not installed shows it too |
| `src/linux/window_icon.rs` (new), `src/linux/wayland/window.rs`, `src/linux/x11/window.rs` | the window's icon in several sizes (16 to 128 pixels and its own, each shrunk by averaging), on Wayland and X11, so a taskbar takes one near its size rather than scaling one large image roughly |
| `src/linux/x11/window.rs` | a window given a display (`WindowOptions::display_id`: the main window's saved place, the viewer's over it) opens exactly where asked: its size hints say the place is the user's and the gravity static, so the window manager keeps it and puts the window itself there, not its frame (upstream: the window manager chooses, and every window is nudged 2 px right); the window's origin is asked of the X server on every configure event (upstream kept the old one after a resize, and GNOME moves a window drawing its own frame as it grows it around its shadow) |
| `src/linux/wayland/window.rs`, `src/linux/x11/window.rs` | a window that is not resizable (`WindowOptions::is_resizable` false: the app's dialog windows) is as small and as large as it is (`xdg_toplevel` min and max size, X11's `WM_NORMAL_HINTS`), kept so as the app resizes it, so the window manager offers no maximize (upstream: ignored on Linux); on Wayland its own title bar (GNOME's, which the app draws) offers no maximize either, and a dialog window's no minimize, as GTK's dialogs |

### Upgrading GPUI Kit

`gpui-component.patch` holds the full diff against upstream 0.7.3. For a new
version:

```sh
cp -r ~/.cargo/registry/src/*/gpui-component-<new>/ vendor/gpui-component-new
cd vendor/gpui-component-new && patch -p1 < ../gpui-component.patch
```

If it applies, replace `gpui-component/` with it and regenerate the patch;
if not, re-make the changes by hand. Drop each change once GPUI Kit covers it.
